messages:
jon: Quick heads-up — planning a rolling sample deploy tomorrow 08:30 PT. Owners: @maria for rollout, @sam for smoke/metrics, @lee for QA signoff. Initial slice plan: 0.5% for 15m -> 2% for 30m -> 10% -> 25% over ~3h. Any objections or known blockers?

maria: I can own the rollout. Confirming the new cache config is pinned and the feature-flag (feature.short_routing) is off by default. Need someone to ack the DB migration window.

sam: I’ll run smoke checks and keep the alert baseline. Rollback criteria I’ll watch: p50 latency > 200ms, error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, or KV cache miss rate > 8%.

lee: QA will run the 100-prompt regression set at +20m on the first slice. If we see quality regressions (BLEU drop or hallucination rate spike) — we stop. I’ll post results into the thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: rolling-deploy triggered by maria at 2025-11-12T08:30:00Z — sequence set to fractional ramp [0.5,2,10,25]%. ETA 3h. :rocket:

maria: Kicking off 0.5% now. Running smoke commands below and watching dashboards.

sam: Smoke checks (examples):
```\n# quick generate check
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","input":"hello"}' \
  https://internal-api.redwood/v1/generate | jq .status

# simple latency probe (repeat 10x)
for i in {1..10}; do time curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://...; done
```
All baseline probes green: p50 145ms, errors 0.02%. Proceeding to 2% in 15m. :thumbsup:

jon: Good. FYI — if KV miss rate jumps we should be ready to pin traffic back and revert the cache config to previous hash (sha256:af3b...). Maria, if you need to abort, post "rollback now" and sam will execute the route flip.

maria: Understood. Rollback plan: route back to model v3.4.1 + revert cache config via `infra rollback-cache --hash af3b...`. Aim for <2min RTO.

lee: After 10% stage completes, I’ll run a manual spot-check on product flows and confirm no downstream errors in ingestion pipeline. I’ll ping here within 10m of completion.

sam: If anything crosses thresholds I’ll trigger pause and notify on-call. Otherwise I’ll promote per plan.

jon: One more ask — telemetry team: please monitor the prompt-based eval job (canary subset) and surface any semantic drift. If QA flags quality, we revert.

maria: 2% ramp started at +15m. Monitoring. Thanks team.

sam: All green for 2% -> scheduling 10% bump at +45m.

lee: QA signoff posted: no significant regressions on the 100-prompt subset.

maria: 10% -> 25% transition in progress. Final validation after 25% completes.

sam: Final checks: p50 152ms, errors 0.03%, KV miss 3.1%. No action.

jon: Great job. Leaving here for the post-mortem notes: include timing, rollback triggers hit/no-hit, and any config changes.

maria: Done — will upload a short runbook + lessons to /shared/releases/2961234567-runbook.md and tag everyone. Thanks.
